text: 文章从肠-脑-皮肤轴视角讨论特应性皮炎的中医证候演变，提出脾虚湿蕴、血虚风燥与肠道微生态失衡、皮肤屏障异常和神经免疫调节紊乱之间存在可解释关联。
source_quote: 提出脾虚湿蕴、血虚风燥与肠道微生态失衡、皮肤屏障异常和神经免疫调节紊乱之间存在可解释关联。

text: 综述特应性皮炎常用中药复方的基础与临床研究，归纳其在 Th2 炎症抑制、屏障修复和瘙痒控制中的潜在作用。
source_quote: 归纳其在 Th2 炎症抑制、屏障修复和瘙痒控制中的潜在作用。

text: 文章归纳了特应性皮炎患者肠道菌群结构改变的主要发现，并讨论菌群干预在免疫稳态恢复中的可能作用。
source_quote: 讨论菌群干预在免疫稳态恢复中的可能作用。

text: 中西医结合诊疗专家共识把皮肤屏障维护、规律外用润肤剂、辨证施治和长期管理列为特应性皮炎的核心要点，并提醒所有结论须结合医生临床判断。
source_quote: 皮肤屏障维护、规律外用润肤剂、辨证施治和长期管理列为特应性皮炎的核心要点

text: 总结药浴、湿敷、软膏与中医外治法在缓解瘙痒、控制渗出和促进皮损修复中的临床证据，并强调与辨证内治相互配合的应用场景。
source_quote: 中医外治法在缓解瘙痒、控制渗出和促进皮损修复中的临床证据

text: 综述指出网络药理学方法常用于筛选中药复方的活性成分、靶点和信号通路，PI3K-Akt、NF-kB、JAK-STAT 等被频繁列为特应性皮炎相关研究的关键调控轴。
source_quote: PI3K-Akt、NF-kB、JAK-STAT 等被频繁列为特应性皮炎相关研究的关键调控轴

text: 围绕儿童特应性皮炎在婴幼儿、学龄前与学龄期的年龄分层，归纳湿热、脾虚、血虚风燥等证型分布与对应的文献证据。

text: 综述提示特应性皮炎中医药研究的持续热点集中在肠-皮肤轴、皮肤屏障、网络药理学和方剂作用通路，证据图谱可围绕这些主题逐步展开。

text: This review summarizes how barrier disruption, alarmins, and type 2 inflammation interact in atopic dermatitis and discusses implications for targeted therapy.
source_quote: barrier disruption, alarmins, and type 2 inflammation interact in atopic dermatitis

text: The study links gut microbial diversity loss and altered metabolite profiles with clinical severity in atopic dermatitis, supporting gut-skin axis hypotheses.
source_quote: gut microbial diversity loss and altered metabolite profiles with clinical severity

text: This review focuses on how neuroimmune crosstalk, including IL-31 signaling and sensory neuron activation, sustains itch in atopic dermatitis.
source_quote: IL-31 signaling and sensory neuron activation sustains itch

text: This review explains why JAK-STAT cytokine signaling has emerged as a major therapeutic axis in atopic dermatitis. Downstream STAT phosphorylation amplifies pathogenic transcription programs in epidermal and immune cells, motivating targeted therapy strategies.
source_quote: JAK-STAT cytokine signaling has emerged as a major therapeutic axis in atopic dermatitis

text: 围绕特应性皮炎瘙痒环路，综述 IL-31、神经肽与瘙痒-搔抓循环之间的相互作用，并梳理中医药内外治在瘙痒控制中的应用思路与文献证据。
source_quote: IL-31、神经肽与瘙痒-搔抓循环之间的相互作用

text: 总结 filaggrin、神经酰胺与角质层功能异常在特应性皮炎屏障损伤中的角色，并讨论中药复方与单体在改善角质层功能、调节炎症因子方面的实验证据。
source_quote: filaggrin、神经酰胺与角质层功能异常在特应性皮炎屏障损伤中的角色

text: The systematic review evaluates herbal formula trials for atopic dermatitis across eczema severity, itch relief, and quality of life outcomes, noting heterogeneous study quality and the need for standardised outcome measures.
source_quote: herbal formula trials for atopic dermatitis across eczema severity, itch relief, and quality of life outcomes

text: Filaggrin loss-of-function variants drive transepidermal water loss and weaken the epidermal barrier in atopic dermatitis, enabling allergen penetration and downstream type 2 inflammation.
source_quote: Filaggrin loss-of-function variants drive transepidermal water loss and weaken the epidermal barrier

text: Probiotic and prebiotic interventions show subgroup-dependent effects on atopic dermatitis severity, with responder heterogeneity and inconsistent strain selection limiting generalisable conclusions across trials.
source_quote: Probiotic and prebiotic interventions show subgroup-dependent effects on atopic dermatitis severity

text: Network pharmacology workflows for atopic dermatitis herbal formulas prioritise active compounds, predicted targets, and enriched pathways such as PI3K-Akt and NF-kB, framing these as hypothesis-generating leads that still require experimental validation.
source_quote: Network pharmacology workflows for atopic dermatitis herbal formulas prioritise active compounds, predicted targets, and enriched pathways

text: Skin microbiome dysbiosis with Staphylococcus aureus dominance correlates with atopic dermatitis flares, barrier injury, and reduced microbial diversity, supporting microbial balance as a therapeutic consideration.
source_quote: Staphylococcus aureus dominance correlates with atopic dermatitis flares, barrier injury, and reduced microbial diversity

text: Pediatric atopic dermatitis phenotypes vary across infancy, preschool, and school-age stages, with longitudinal management emphasising barrier maintenance, flare prevention, and developmentally appropriate care strategies.
source_quote: Pediatric atopic dermatitis phenotypes vary across infancy, preschool, and school-age stages
